units.behaviour: Provide pure range algebra for normalizing, merging, splitting, applying, shifting on edit, querying, and line-projecting `TextRangeStyle` spans over `originalText`.
rules: 1. `isValidRangeColor(color: unknown): color is string` returns `true` iff `typeof color === "string"` and `color.trim().length > 0` and `color.trim().toLowerCase() !== "transparent"`.

2. `normalizeTextRanges(ranges: unknown, textLength: number): readonly TextRangeStyle[] | undefined` returns `undefined` if `!Array.isArray(ranges)` or `textLength <= 0` or `ranges.length === 0`; clamps each entry's finite `start`/`end` integers into `[0, textLength]`, drops entries with `start >= end` or neither valid `color` nor valid `highlightColor`, splits overlapping intervals at all sorted unique boundary points so later entries override earlier entries per defined channel (`color` independently of `highlightColor`) while preserving the other channel from earlier entries, merges adjacent intervals that have `prev.end === curr.start && prev.color === curr.color && prev.highlightColor === curr.highlightColor`, omits undefined channel keys from each `TextRangeStyle` object, and returns `undefined` when empty.

3. `areTextRangesEqual(a: readonly TextRangeStyle[] | undefined, b: readonly TextRangeStyle[] | undefined): boolean` treats `undefined` and `[]` as equal and returns `true` iff both arrays have equal length and identical `start`, `end`, `color`, and `highlightColor` at every index.

4. `applyTextRangeStyle(ranges: readonly TextRangeStyle[] | undefined, textLength: number, start: number, end: number, style: { color?: string | null; highlightColor?: string | null }, baseStrokeColor?: string): readonly TextRangeStyle[] | undefined` clamps `[start, end)` to `[0, textLength]`; if `s >= e` or `textLength <= 0`, returns `normalizeTextRanges(ranges, textLength)`. Splits existing normalized ranges at `s` and `e`; when `"color" in style`, sets `color` on `[s, e)` if `isValidRangeColor(style.color)` and `(!baseStrokeColor || style.color.trim().toLowerCase() !== baseStrokeColor.trim().toLowerCase())`, otherwise clears the `color` channel on `[s, e)`; when `"highlightColor" in style`, sets `highlightColor` on `[s, e)` if `isValidRangeColor(style.highlightColor)`, otherwise clears the `highlightColor` channel on `[s, e)`; normalizes and merges the result via `normalizeTextRanges`.

5. `computeTextEditDelta(prevText: string, nextText: string): TextEditDelta` computes common prefix length `start` and non-overlapping common suffix length `suffixLen`, returning `{ start, deleteCount: prevText.length - start - suffixLen, insertLength: nextText.length - start - suffixLen }`.

6. `shiftTextRangesOnEdit(ranges: readonly TextRangeStyle[] | undefined, prevText: string, nextText: string): readonly TextRangeStyle[] | undefined` returns `undefined` if `!ranges?.length || nextText.length === 0`, or `normalizeTextRanges(ranges, nextText.length)` if `prevText === nextText`. Otherwise uses `computeTextEditDelta(prevText, nextText)` (`dStart = start`, `dEnd = start + deleteCount`, `dLen = deleteCount`, `k = insertLength`) to transform each range in two steps: first delete `[dStart, dEnd)` (`s1 = r.start <= dStart ? r.start : r.start >= dEnd ? r.start - dLen : dStart`, `e1 = r.end <= dStart ? r.end : r.end >= dEnd ? r.end - dLen : dStart`, dropping if `s1 >= e1`), then insert `k` at `dStart` (`s2 = s1 >= dStart ? s1 + k : s1`, `e2 = e1 > dStart ? e1 + k : e1`), and returns `normalizeTextRanges(shifted, nextText.length)`.

7. `getStyleForTextRange(ranges: readonly TextRangeStyle[] | undefined, start: number, end: number, defaultStrokeColor: string): { color: string; highlightColor: string }` returns `{ color: defaultStrokeColor, highlightColor: "transparent" }` when `start >= end` or `!ranges?.length`; otherwise inspects normalized ranges overlapping `[start, end)` and returns a uniform `color` if ranges completely cover `[start, end)` with the same `color` (else `defaultStrokeColor`) and a uniform `highlightColor` if ranges completely cover `[start, end)` with the same `highlightColor` (else `"transparent"`).

8. `projectTextRangesToLines(originalText: string, wrappedText: string, ranges: readonly TextRangeStyle[] | undefined): readonly (readonly TextLineRun[])[]` normalizes newlines (`
?` -> `
`) on both inputs, splits `wrappedText` on `"
"`, advances a cursor `pos` through `originalText` to locate each line's `[lineStart, lineEnd)` offset in `originalText` (skipping soft-wrap trimmed whitespace via `originalText.indexOf(lineText, pos)` and advancing past at most one `
` after each line), and slices each line `[lineStart, lineEnd)` against `normalizeTextRanges(ranges, originalText.length)` into contiguous `TextLineRun` segments `{ text, start, end, ...(color ? { color } : {}), ...(highlightColor ? { highlightColor } : {}) }`.

Define helper `applyEditingTextRangeUpdate(elements, appState, style: { color?: string | null; highlightColor?: string | null }, requireNonEmptySelection: boolean)`: when `appState.editingTextElement` is open, finds the live text element in `elements`, reads `selection = getWysiwygSelectionRange()`; if `requireNonEmptySelection` and `(!selection || selection.start >= selection.end)`, returns `null`; resolves `[start, end] = selection && selection.start < selection.end ? [] }, true)` and if `!nextRanges` deletes `(updatedEl as Mutable<ExcalidrawTextElement>).textRanges`; calls `syncWysiwygTextRangesStyle(updatedEl, appState.theme)`; returns `{ elements: elements.map((el) => (el.id === updatedEl.id ? updatedEl : el)), editingTextElement: updatedEl }`.

In `actionChangeStrokeColor.perform`: resolve `effectiveColor = color ?? appStateUpdates.currentItemStrokeColor`; if `effectiveColor !== undefined`, try `const rangeResult = applyEditingTextRangeUpdate(elements, appState, { color: effectiveColor }, true)`; if `rangeResult` is non-null, return `{ elements: rangeResult.elements, appState: { ...appState, ...appStateUpdates, editingTextElement: rangeResult.editingTextElement }, captureUpdate: appState.newElement ? CaptureUpdateAction.EVENTUALLY : CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY }`; otherwise execute the existing whole-element stroke color update.

4. In `actionChangeBackgroundColor.perform`: resolve `effectiveColor = color ?? appStateUpdates.currentItemBackgroundColor`; if `effectiveColor !== undefined`, try `const rangeResult = applyEditingTextRangeUpdate(elements, appState, { highlightColor: effectiveColor }, true)`; if `rangeResult` is non-null, return `{ elements: rangeResult.elements, appState: { ...appState, ...appStateUpdates, editingTextElement: rangeResult.editingTextElement }, captureUpdate: appState.newElement ? CaptureUpdateAction.EVENTUALLY : CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY }`; otherwise execute the existing background color update.

units.behaviour: Render `<rect>` background highlights and `<tspan>` foreground colour runs in SVG export when a text element has `textRanges`.
rules: 1. Import `getFontString` from `@excalidraw/common` and `measureText`, `projectTextRangesToLines` from `@excalidraw/element`.

2. In `renderElementToSvg` (`if (isTextElement(element))`): when `!element.textRanges?.length`, keep the existing loop that creates one `<text>` element per line with `text.textContent = lines[i]` unchanged so existing SVG snapshots do not change.

3. When `element.textRanges?.length` is non-empty, compute `const lineRuns = projectTextRangesToLines(element.originalText, element.text.replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n"), element.textRanges)` and `const fontString = getFontString(element)`. For each line `i`, let `runs = lineRuns[i] ?? [{ text: lines[i], start: 0, end: lines[i].length }]`. If `runs.some((r) => r.highlightColor)`, measure `lineWidth = measureText(lines[i], fontString, element.lineHeight, renderConfig.renderEnvironment).width`, compute `lineStartX = element.textAlign === "center" ? (element.width - lineWidth) / 2 : element.textAlign === "right" ? element.width - lineWidth : 0`, advance across `runs` (left-to-right from `lineStartX` when `direction === "ltr"`, right-to-left from `lineStartX + lineWidth` when `direction === "rtl"`) using `runWidth = measureText(run.text, fontString, element.lineHeight, renderConfig.renderEnvironment).width`, and for each run with `run.highlightColor` append an SVG `<rect>` (`x`, `y = i * lineHeightPx`, `width = runWidth`, `height = lineHeightPx`, `fill = applyDarkModeFilter(run.highlightColor, renderConfig.theme === THEME.DARK)`) to `node` before `<text>`. For `<text>`, if `runs.length === 1 && !runs[0].color`, set `text.textContent = lines[i]`; otherwise append a `<tspan>` per run with `tspan.textContent = run.text` and (when `run.color` is defined) `tspan.setAttribute("fill", applyDarkModeFilter(run.color, renderConfig.theme === THEME.DARK))`.
